impact: The selected gamma amounts/dates and trade/cash results reconciled. The unresolved problem is whether a checkpoint is described as recorded decision evidence versus subsequently added analysis. Do not train an ML feature pipeline from that provenance flag without correcting or bypassing it using canonical saved decisions.

Choose provenance per checkpoint in cards, basis-specific exports and coverage. No time rounding backward, fabricated receipt or financial replay.
